subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------EXP.DY.
description: Diagram opening MP(II)-13 (the U.S.A. subsection on the changing position of the United States as a world power). The prose immediately above the diagram identifies the structural target: 'it is important to examine aspects of world culture with emphasis on progressional continuance and political reality — and political transition.' The crossing diagrams how time-continuum-implications structurally meets expansion-dynamics at the world-power-position scale: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) crossed with EXP-DY (expansion dynamics — the actual expansion dynamics by which world-power-position registers). T-C-IMP sits on the left with the subject-arrow; TR rises from the main line at upper-left, UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) branches from the TR line at top-center, and C-CONT (composite continuance) branches from the UNF-PI line. EXP-DY is the partner at the end of the main line at center-right. OBS (observation) branches from the main line down to the right; BSCI branches from the OBS line, and POST (postulation) and FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics) both branch from the BSCI line on the right margin. DEC (decentralization) drops from the main line to the bottom; MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis, written 'mt.if.db.') branches from the DEC line, and PRI-INFO (principle information) from the MT-IF-DB line.
